name: The Coiled One
description: A huge serpent-like being called up by Saryth and fed with villagers, which retreats into the earth when the mask is torn off.

timeline.summary: That night Sinnia, still masked, tells Leinore that the Coiled One has spoken to her and is surfacing.
timeline.quote: The Coiled One has spoken to me today, sister.

timeline.summary: The ground splits and the Coiled One begins to rise from a chasm as Saryth screams that it is time and wounds Katilda.
Sinnia whispers for help and Leinore tears the fused mask off her face as the Coiled One bends to swallow them.
timeline.quote: Without thinking she started to pull as hard as she could.

timeline.summary: With the mask gone the Coiled One bellows and retreats into the earth, pulling the eggs down with it.
timeline.quote: With one last hiss, the Coiled One dragged its body to the depths of the earth

relations.note: She called it and fed it ensorcelled villagers.
relations.quote: Saryth called him to chase the darkness away and has been feeding him those ensorcelled townsfolk for days now.
